email.subject1: a signal play for Higher Logic
email.body1:
Richard, saw Higher Logic just launched the Vanilla MCP Server, opening community data to AI tools.

A launch like that usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before signal cools, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Higher Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Richard, quick follow-up for Higher Logic.

A new AI capability usually drives demand faster than headcount can cover it. Most VPs of Sales don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Higher Logic needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Richard, last bit of proof for Higher Logic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Higher Logic's reply rate likely compares to similar software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Richard, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A product launch tends to eat the calendar.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Higher Logic either way.
